
=== header

  HA NOVA Setup
  -------------

=== intro

  Welcome! HA NOVA lets your AI assistant run your Home Assistant.

  Steps: pick your AI client, find Home Assistant, add the NOVA App, connect this computer, install the skills.
  When a browser page opens, finish there and come back here.
  You need the Home Assistant owner's account.
  Home Assistant Link only: the NOVA App must already be installed.

=== step

  [2/4] Step 2 of 4 – Connect this computer

  HA NOVA Setup
  -------------

  This device still connects with the shared legacy token.

  enter a fresh code from the NOVA page ("Connect a device").

  Run 'ha-nova doctor' for full diagnostics.

=== incomplete: generic

  [!!] Setup incomplete

  HA NOVA saved your local setup, but the system is not fully ready yet.
  Then run "ha-nova setup" again — it continues where you left off.


=== incomplete: relay_unreachable

  [!!] Setup incomplete

  HA NOVA saved your local setup, but the relay could not be verified yet.
  Open Home Assistant > Settings > Apps > NOVA Relay (older Home Assistant: Settings > Add-ons) and start the app.
  Then run "ha-nova setup" again — it continues where you left off.


=== incomplete: ws_degraded

  [!!] Setup incomplete

  The NOVA App is reachable, but its Home Assistant connection is not up yet.
  Open Home Assistant > Settings > Apps > NOVA Relay (older Home Assistant: Settings > Add-ons), verify the app settings, and restart the App.
  Then run "ha-nova setup" again — it continues where you left off.


=== incomplete: skills_install

  [!!] Setup incomplete

  Re-run setup or install the HA NOVA skills again for your client.
